Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations sustain momentum.

Silver.note: Strong industrial solar demand combined with monetary premium drives outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and grid modernization demand outweigh macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and restarting global nuclear capacity support prices.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new Australian and African projects pressures margins.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and LFP battery substitution weigh on Class 1 premiums.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter treatment charge collapses support metal prices.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property sector offsets infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Thermal demand stabilizes while seaborne metallurgical supply remains constrained.

Rare Earths.note: Weak near-term EV motor demand offsets strategic supply chain stockpiling.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production balances against gradual high-purity battery demand growth.

PGM.note: Declining global auto production and ICE transition cap near-term catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Global agricultural application rates normalize following previous supply chain shocks.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and rising green energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Heavy weighting in copper and gold offsets weaker iron ore and coal exposures.
